name: Meletis
description: Meletis, the City of the Twelve, is a polis on Theros devoted to learning, philosophy and the gods, and is where Ephara is particularly worshipped.

timeline.summary: Perisophia opens a lesson in Meletis by asking her students what identity is, using the example of a leonin cub raised by wolves.
timeline.quote: "What is identity? What makes us who we are?"

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Perisophia urges her students to dwell in the mystery rather than hastily answering.
timeline.quote: Dwell in the mystery for a bit and see what arises.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Melia cites Phelos, and Perisophia presses whether identity can be an object of knowledge.
timeline.quote: Can you know yourself? Can your identity be an object of knowledge, or is it something entirely different?

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Samia asks about the Returned and eidolons, and Perisophia explains that they lack the capacity for an identity.
timeline.quote: It would appear that the Returned and the eidolons lack the capacity for an identity.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Salis raises the story of Matatios, and Perisophia warns that Matatios only met himself and did not become aware of himself.
timeline.quote: Matatios did not become aware of himself, he only met himself.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Perisophia ends the lesson by saying that identity lives in the moment and that each person is the architect of it.
timeline.quote: Identity is not in the past, nor does it dwell in the future. It lives in the moment.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Soldiers in Meletis note that a third child has vanished this month and no one knows what happened.
timeline.quote: "That makes three so far this month."

citation.text: "Dance of the Flitterstep" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Misty child spirits play through the agora at dawn and vanish into the walls, and Perisophia declares the children at rest.
timeline.quote: "The children are at rest.

citation.text: "Dance of the Flitterstep" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Iris refuses to hide, but Perisophia and the Twelve decide she must be moved to the garrison at Soli because enemy agents have infiltrated Meletis.
timeline.quote: We have conferred with the Temple and agreed that you will be moved to the garrison at Soli

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Alexio is presented as Iris's bodyguard; when she touches him she has a vision that he will fall in love with her and be taken from her, and resolves to prevent it.
timeline.quote: He was in love with her.

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Iris and Alexio leave Meletis at dawn on the overland route south through the forest.
timeline.quote: Perisophia let go of Iris's hand as Alexio led her horse away

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Iris gallops carelessly away from Alexio, and he swoops down and saves her from an ambush by two men he believes are worshipers of Purphoros; her horse is lamed and put down.
timeline.quote: Judging by the markings on their weapons, I would guess they were worshipers of Purphoros.

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Pursuers find the dead ambushers and the horse and track the Oracle and the Skyguard.
timeline.quote: Men, we will be home with our captive and the head of a Skyguard before the moon is full.

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Alexio brings a friendly pegasus as a mount, and Iris and Alexio fly toward the mountains.
timeline.quote: Hold fast, but know that he will not let you fall.

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: In a dream, Euneas watches the Meletian plaza crushed beneath endless replacement columns until the city swallows him whole; he wakes screaming.
timeline.quote: The city had claimed him whole, another piece of sediment for the streets future inhabitants would trod upon in their brief doomed hours.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Transformed, Zosimos leaves the path to Meletis and follows a pull toward the eastern mountains, abandoning thoughts he calls the seeds of Phenax.
timeline.quote: Now he followed his destiny.

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Diantha brings the Oracle of Kruphix her meal in Meletis and the oracle says Kruphix once spirited her away to his true temple.
timeline.quote: When I was in danger, Kruphix spirited me away to his temple.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Back in Meletis, the oracle tells Diantha she learned nothing to share, and gazes into the distance.
timeline.quote: There is nothing. Nothing at all.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Meletis is founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire with Kynaios and Tiro as guardians.
timeline.quote: The polis of Meletis was founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire as a beacon of freedom and enlightenment

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!

timeline.summary: Thrasios leaves Meletis on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths.
timeline.quote: Thrasios has left his home and embarked on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths at the edge of the world.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: A chariot accident blinds Tymna and ends her career among the Battlewise of Meletis.
timeline.quote: A career filled with victories was cut short by a chariot accident, leaving her blind.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Elspeth falls to Theros and is welcomed by Daxos's voice; she sees Meletis in ruins.
timeline.quote: "So you've not forgotten me, even with the new station,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth sees Ajani in Heliod's temple, converting gods and forcing a priestess to drink Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: He's already changed three of them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Heroes of Theros shoot at Ajani, and he has a captured youth killed before the faithful.
timeline.quote: "Behold, one who turns away from the pack! One who plots against us!"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth weighs saving Theros against the larger war, and concludes the choice is not meant to be about her own wants.
timeline.quote: But this isn't meant to be about her own wants and needs.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Mortals endure and thrive on Theros behind the walls of great poleis, each a bulwark against raging monsters.
timeline.quote: each city-state a bulwark against the raging monsters that roam the more savage places of Theros.

citation.text: "Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
